title: Lumi the Little Seaplane and the Festival of Floating Lights
description: A little lavender seaplane and her mint-green friend glide above a lakeside Festival of Floating Lights, then rest side by side in their cozy boathouse under the moon.

Lumi.color: Soft lavender fuselage and wings with a warm creamy-white belly, nose, and twin pontoons
Lumi.bodyShape: Small rounded high-wing seaplane with exactly two creamy-white floats, one front two-blade propeller, and chubby childlike proportions; no wheels, arms, or hands
Lumi.face: Two large expressive dark-brown eyes on the forward windshield and a small sweet smile on the creamy-white front nose
Lumi.accessories: Exactly one small golden-yellow five-point star on each visible side of the lavender tail fin

Fable.role: Supporting character; a tiny mint-green seaplane
Fable.color: Pale mint-green fuselage and wings with a light buttercream belly, nose, and petite twin pontoons
Fable.bodyShape: Visibly smaller high-wing seaplane about 75% of Lumi size, with exactly two buttercream floats and one front two-blade propeller; no wheels, arms, or hands
Fable.face: Two large expressive deep-hazel eyes on the forward windshield and a small cheerful curved smile below
Fable.accessories: Exactly one small solid coral-pink circular marking on each visible side of the mint-green tail fin

settingBible.Lantern Lake Valley: A peaceful mountain lake with a honey-brown wooden dock, sage-green boathouse, pastel village, willow trees, floating golden lanterns, and rounded blue-violet mountains
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded seaplanes, golden evening fading to moonlit festival lights, one scene per page, and no readable text

continuityRules: Lumi stays lavender with creamy-white pontoons, windshield eyes, and one golden tail star per visible side.
Fable stays mint green with buttercream pontoons, a coral-pink tail circle, and first appears on page 4.
Fable remains about 75% of Lumi size.
Floating lanterns appear on the water from page 6 onward; the festival stays gentle with no fireworks or danger.
Pages 14–15 show both seaplanes resting and asleep side by side in the boathouse.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words.

pages.text: Beside a sparkling blue lake, a little lavender seaplane named Lumi loved gliding across the water.
pages.illustrationScene: Lavender seaplane Lumi glides across a sparkling blue lake watching fluffy clouds drift overhead.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Lumi: soft lavender, creamy-white nose/pontoons, golden tail star, dark-brown windshield eyes, two floats. Fable absent.

pages.text: Every evening, Lumi rested near a cozy wooden dock while the distant mountains turned golden in the setting sun.
pages.illustrationScene: Every evening Lumi rests near a cozy wooden dock as distant mountains turn golden in the setting sun.
pages.continuityNotes: Lumi alone near dock and sage-green boathouse; golden sunset.

pages.text: One special evening, the lakeside village began preparing for its Festival of Floating Lights with glowing lanterns.
pages.illustrationScene: The lakeside village prepares for the Festival of Floating Lights, hanging glowing lanterns along docks and paths.
pages.continuityNotes: Lumi alone watching festival preparations; hanging lanterns begin glowing.

pages.text: Lumi's friend, a tiny mint-green seaplane named Fable, floated over and whispered that tonight the whole lake would sparkle.
pages.illustrationScene: Tiny mint-green seaplane Fable floats over with a happy smile and joins Lumi on the water.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Fable: pale mint green, buttercream floats, coral-pink tail circle, ~75% Lumi size.

pages.text: As the sun slipped behind the mountains, Lumi and Fable gently lifted into the evening sky.
pages.illustrationScene: Lumi and Fable gently lift into the evening sky as the sun slips behind the mountains.
pages.continuityNotes: Both take off gently; no danger or racing.

pages.text: Below them, families placed beautiful floating lanterns onto the quiet lake until its surface shimmered with soft light.
pages.illustrationScene: From above, families place floating lanterns on the quiet lake until the surface shimmers with soft light.
pages.continuityNotes: Airborne above floating lanterns starting on the lake.

pages.text: “Look, Fable,” Lumi whispered, for the lanterns looked like sleepy stars floating on the water.
pages.illustrationScene: Lumi whispers that the lanterns look like sleepy stars floating on the water.
pages.continuityNotes: Lanterns like sleepy stars; calm wonder.

pages.text: The two little seaplanes flew slowly above the festival, watching colorful lights glow between rooftops and willow trees.
pages.illustrationScene: The two little seaplanes fly slowly above the festival near village rooftops and tall willow trees.
pages.continuityNotes: Slow flight near rooftops and willows, above hanging lights.

pages.text: A gentle evening breeze carried soft music from the village square, but the tiny bells only chimed as lanterns swayed.
pages.illustrationScene: A gentle breeze carries soft village-square music as lanterns sway beneath a deepening purple sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Village square lanterns and tiny bells; soft music mood.

pages.text: Lumi and Fable circled above the moonlit lake, admiring golden ribbons of lantern light across the still, dark water.
pages.illustrationScene: Lumi and Fable circle above the moonlit lake where floating lanterns make golden ribbons of light.
pages.continuityNotes: Moonlit lake circle; golden lantern ribbons.

pages.text: “I wish we could keep this beautiful evening forever,” Lumi murmured, as the first bright stars twinkled above.
pages.illustrationScene: Lumi murmurs wishing to keep the beautiful evening as bright stars twinkle above quiet mountains.
pages.continuityNotes: Night over far lake; stars; Lumi quiet wonder.

pages.text: “We can remember it in our dreams,” Fable replied sleepily, and together they glided toward their familiar wooden dock.
pages.illustrationScene: Fable replies sleepily and together they glide toward their familiar wooden dock.
pages.continuityNotes: Turn toward familiar dock; Fable sleepy; together.

pages.text: With two tiny splashes, the friends settled onto the calm lake and drifted slowly home.
pages.illustrationScene: With two tiny splashes the friends settle onto the calm lake and drift slowly home.
pages.continuityNotes: Land with tiny splashes near dock; drowsy.

pages.text: Beneath their cozy lakeside boathouse, Lumi and Fable rested side by side as the last lanterns glimmered across the water.
pages.illustrationScene: Inside their cozy lakeside boathouse, Lumi and Fable rest side by side as last lanterns glimmer outside.
pages.continuityNotes: Side by side in open-front boathouse berths; distant lanterns.

pages.text: Under the silver moon and quiet stars, Lumi and Fable closed their sleepy eyes and drifted peacefully to sleep.
pages.illustrationScene: Under the silver moon, Lumi and Fable sleep peacefully side by side in the boathouse with eyes closed.
pages.continuityNotes: Both fully asleep in same boathouse positions; peaceful ending.
